X. (Professor) (Dartry, Dublin) (14th November 2024) peacefully after a short illness at St. James's Hospital, predeceased by her sisters Liobháin (Meenan) and Keara (Kyra) and dear aunt of Frances, Charles and John, deeply regretted by her niece, nephews, grandnieces, grandnephews, great grandnieces, relatives and friends. Beloved son of the late John and Vera, devoted husband of Anna, much loved father of Aisling, Ronan, Killian and Dervla. Dear father-in-law of Niall, Parul, Fiona and Richard. Cherished grandfather to Freya, Tom, Elijah, Kian, Mira, Oisín and Fionn. Much loved granda of the late Isaac. Reposing at home 3A Kensington Park from 12.00 noon on Tuesday 22nd October. Patrick's remains will be brought to St Colmcille's Church, Ballyhackamore at 6.30pm on Wednesday 23rd October. Requiem Mass in St Colmcille's Church, Ballyhackamore at 12.00 noon on Thursday 24th October followed by committal in Roselawn Crematorium. Deeply regretted by his loving family circle. Wicklow) April 25, 2024 (peacefully) after a short illness in St. Vincent's University Hospital. Beloved wife of Martin and loving mother of Anne, Eleanor, Elizabeth, Martin, Mary Clare, Margaret and Michael. She will be sadly missed and remembered with love and affection by all her family; sisters Mary, Margaret, Helen and Bridget; brothers John, Martin and (predeceased) Jim; brother and sister-in-law; daughter-in-law, sons-in-law; cherished grandchildren Eleanor, James, Finn, Elsie, Cecilia, Pearse, Elizabeth, Oliver, Hannah, Edward and Grace; nieces, nephews, extended family, friends and neighbours. Reposing at home on Tuesday evening from 5pm to 7pm. Removal on Wednesday morning to the Church of the Holy Cross, Dundrum arriving for Funeral Mass at 10.30am followed by cremation

He will be sadly missed by his brother Br. Felix, sisters Moira Leonard (Dublin) and Ita Scott (Kilkenny), relatives and friends. Rest in peace.
